scripts.install:all: npm --prefix shell install && npm --prefix products install && npm --prefix cart install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shell,products,cart -c blue,green,yellow "npm --prefix shell run dev" "npm --prefix products run dev" "npm --prefix cart run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix shell run lint && npm --prefix products run lint && npm --prefix cart run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix shell exec -- tsc -b shell && npm --prefix products exec -- tsc -b products && npm --prefix cart exec -- tsc -b cart
scripts.build: npm --prefix shell run build && npm --prefix products run build && npm --prefix cart run build
